desc: Parse N, M and all known cell constraints, preserving N’s large bound without expanding the grid.
Group constraints by row, computing for each constrained row L = max black y and R = min white y − 1 (defaults L=0, R=N).
Reject immediately if any row has L > R.
Sort constrained rows by row index and scan top-to-bottom, maintaining the minimum R seen so far.
For each row, check whether its L ≤ current minimum R; if not, answer No, otherwise update the minimum and continue.
If all rows pass, output Yes; otherwise output No, and verify against all sample cases.
